title: What Interview Prep Guide Is and Why It Matters

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Interview Prep Guide
summary: Start interview prep guide this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Research company deeply (news, product, reviews)
2. Map your stories to the job description
3. Practice STAR answers out loud
4. Prepare 5 smart questions for them
5. Plan logistics: route, outfit, materials

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: Interview Prep Guide: Safety, Legal, and Fine Print
summary: What to watch out for with interview prep guide: safety, contracts, and fine print.
body:
Read before you act: No company research And: Rambling without STAR structure

General rules: get agreements in writing, understand what you're signing, keep records of money in and out, and know when a professional (lawyer, accountant, vet, doctor — depending on the domain) is worth the fee. An hour of professional advice beats a month of fixing.
